## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle (10卷) **Línjì-school commentary** on the *Śūraṃgama-sūtra* ([KR6j0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0118)) by **Xìngfú Huìgōng Jìshí** 興福會公濟時 [濟時](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BF%9F%E6%99%82), abbot of the *Gǔ Xìngfú Chánsì* 古興福禪寺 at Lóudōng 婁東 (Tàicāng, Jiāngsū). The author identifies himself in the colophon as *Zhù Lóudōng Gǔ Xìngfú Chánsì shāmén Jìshí shù* 住婁東古興福禪寺沙門濟時述. Preserved as **X16 no. 317** in the *Xùzàngjīng*. The title — *zhèngjiàn* 正見, "right view" — frames the work as a corrective to the proliferating sectarian *Lèngyán* commentarial divisions.

**Abstract**

The *Zhèngjiàn* is the principal **Línjì-school commentary** of the late seventeenth century, complementing [元賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E8%B3%A2)'s Cáodòng-school *Lüèshū* ([KR6j0710](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0710)), the Tiāntái-school *Dìngjiě* ([KR6j0714](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0714)), the Huáyán-school *Bǎojìng shū* ([KR6j0724](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0724)) and *Zhǐzhǎng shū* ([KR6j0716](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0716)). It is described as the product of three years' "withered sitting" (*kūzuò sānnián* 枯坐三年) followed by a single night's awakening, after which Jìshí "fused them together within the single mind / threefold contemplation" (*rónghuì yú yīxīn sānguān* 融會於一心三觀). Composition: 1698–1699.
